title.narrative: Trade Related Assistance for Mongolia (TRAM)

description.narrative: The project aims at contributing to enhance Mongolia's international trade and economic diversification and to sustainable economic growth and development of the country, with the ultimate goal of reducing poverty and external vulnerabilities.The purpose is to support Mongolian public institutions and private sector for effective trade policy initiatives with a special focus on specific products/sectors with high potencial, to effectively participate in world economy.

title.narrative: EU requirements for customs matters adopted

description.narrative: EU requirements for customs matters adoptedEU requirements for customs matters adopted

comment.narrative: The trade related agreements and documentations were entirely revised with accurate translations to adopt the trade facilitation measures for EU requirementsTRAM contributed to the better understanding of the EU REX system for customs officers and other institutions like MNCCI GASI MASM MFA and four export clusters. After the law adopted associated regulations and guidelines will be advocated for customs matters
